en: The postcard features an image of two prominent buildings, one of which is a grand, historic-looking academic institution, and the other a large church with a tall spire and clock tower. The buildings are surrounded by neatly kept trees and open grounds. The upper left of the image contains the printed text: 'Sundsvall. Allm. Läroverket och Kyrkan.' The reverse side of the postcard displays multiple languages for the word postcard, handwriting in Swedish, a Swedish stamp, and postal markings.
